stops.name: Monfragüe
stops.detail: Monfragüe is a comarca in Extremadura, western Spain, and the site of Monfragüe National Park. The national park lies in the province of Cáceres, roughly between Plasencia, Trujillo, and the city of Cáceres. It covers 18,118 hectares (181.18 km2) and extends along the valley of the Tagus River, where the Tiétar River joins it. Its habitats include extensive scrubland, oak woodland, cliffs, and rocky outcrops.
